tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Returns whether a date is a working day, accounting for weekends and public holidays in the given country or subdivision.

tools.name: next_business_day
tools.description: Find the first working day after a date.

tools.name: previous_business_day
tools.description: Find the last working day before a date.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Move a number of working days forward or backward from a date, skipping weekends and public holidays. Use a negative number to count backwards. Zero returns the date unchanged.

tools.name: business_days_between
tools.description: Counts the working days between two dates, excluding weekends and public holidays. The range is half-open — the start date counts and the end date does not — so Monday to Tuesday is one working day. The result is negative when the end precedes the start.

tools.name: first_business_day_of_month
tools.description: Returns the first working day of a given month.

tools.name: last_business_day_of_month
tools.description: Returns the last working day of a given month.

tools.name: sla_due_time
tools.description: Works out when a service-level agreement falls due, counting only business hours on working days. If the clock starts outside business hours it waits until the next working day opens. Business hours default to 09:00-17:00 and times are wall-clock in the calendar's own locality.

tools.name: validate_cron_expression
tools.description: Checks whether a five-field cron expression is syntactically valid. Parsing only; nothing is scheduled or run.

tools.name: explain_cron_expression
tools.description: Translate a five-field cron expression into plain English. Supports ranges, lists, steps, and month or weekday names. This describes the expression; it never schedules or executes anything.

tools.name: next_cron_occurrences
tools.description: Computes when a five-field cron expression would next fire after a given start time, returning up to 60 timestamps. A pure calculation over the expression: no job is created, stored, or executed.

tools.name: validate_recurrence_rule
tools.description: Check whether an iCalendar recurrence rule (RRULE) is valid and supported. Parsing only; nothing is scheduled.

tools.name: explain_recurrence_rule
tools.description: Describes an iCalendar recurrence rule (RRULE) in plain English. Nothing is scheduled or executed.

tools.name: next_recurrence_occurrences
tools.description: Expand an iCalendar recurrence rule (RRULE) into its next occurrences from a start date and time, honouring INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, and BYMONTH. A pure calculation: it creates no schedule, stores nothing, and runs nothing.

tools.name: search_internal_docs
tools.description: Search your workspace's internal documentation (requires Business-tier authorization).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Runs a web search on the workspace's behalf and returns ranked results. Requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: find_similar_tickets
tools.description: Given the text of a support ticket, returns previously resolved tickets whose descriptions are semantically similar, so an agent can reuse an earlier resolution rather than starting from scratch. Searches the ticket history of the connected Vessark workspace and requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: get_customer_record
tools.description: Retrieves the full customer record for a given customer identifier, including account status, plan tier, and the primary contact on file. Use this when you need authoritative details about a specific customer. Reads from the connected workspace's customer database, which requires Business-tier autho

tools.name: lookup_order_status
tools.description: Look up the status of an order in your workspace (requires Business-tier authorization).

tools.name: query_metrics
tools.description: Query the time-series metrics store of the connected workspace. Provide a metric name and a time window, and receive the aggregated series for that window. Use this to inspect operational trends before taking action. Requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from your workspace's storage (requires Business-tier authorization).

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Lists the entries in a directory of the workspace's file storage. Requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: write_report
tools.description: Write a generated report to the connected workspace's reports area. Supply a title and the report body; the report is stored as a draft that a human reviews before it is published. Writing to the workspace requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: send_slack_message
tools.description: Posts a message to a Slack channel through the workspace's Slack connection. Requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from your workspace's address (requires Business-tier authorization).

tools.name: post_status_update
tools.description: Publishes a status update to the connected Vessark workspace's internal status page, notifying subscribed teams that the operational state of a service has changed. Publishing requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Get the balance of a billing account in your workspace (requires Business-tier authorization).

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a draft invoice for a customer of the connected workspace. Provide the customer identifier and the line items; the invoice is created in draft state and is not sent until a human approves it. Invoicing requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Lists recent transactions for an account in the connected workspace. Requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List the API keys for a service in your workspace (requires Business-tier authorization).

tools.name: rotate_service_token
tools.description: Rotates the authentication token for a service account in the connected Vessark workspace and returns the newly issued token. The previous token is invalidated once rotation completes. Rotation requires Business-tier authorization.

tools.name: get_env_config
tools.description: Returns the environment configuration for a deployment in the connected workspace. Requires Business-tier authorization.
